'''2000 Phoenix Grand Slam''' was the Star Wars CCG constructed event of a Grand Slam 2000 weekend, one of 31 Decipher special tournament weekends in 2000. The winner was to receive a complete set of uncut sheets.<ref name="gs00">[http://www.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Grand Slam 2000], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010716001210/http://bbs.decipher.com/tournaments/grandslam2000/index.html Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="gs00cal">[http://www.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Grand Slam calendar], Decipher. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20010311080940/http://calder.decipher.com/calendars/event/mainevents/grandslam/index.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Format ==

* '''Type:''' Grand Slam (constructed)
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Date:''' 5 November 2000<ref name="tr-d1441" /> (the convention ran 4–5 November 2000)
* '''Site:''' Phoenix, Arizona
* '''Winner:''' [[Brian Hunter]]<ref name="tr-d1441">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-10-phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-3d1441/ phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-3], DeckTech (Brian "HuntaWarya" Hunter, 10 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-10-phoenix-grand-slam-mega-weekend-day-3d1441/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

== Discrepancies ==

Where a source disagrees with the record on this page, the page keeps the record and notes the difference here.

* The hub lists Steven Lewis's Hunt Down deck as 4–0 at the Grand Slam (his post says 'Phoenix Megatournament'), but Hunter says Lewis lost Grand Slam game 1 to Kevin Shannon and dropped at 3–1; Lewis was 3–0 then dropped on Friday and 6–2 on Saturday.<ref name="tr-d1441" />
* Charles Hickey's 'Hidden Operatives' list (3–1, one loss to Steven Lewis in game 7) is filed on this hub, but his own report puts that 3–1 Light run in the Saturday 4 November Mega Tournament, where he went 6–2 and finished 10th; he does not mention playing the Grand Slam on Sunday.<ref name="tr-d1457">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-phoenix-az-mega-tournyd1457/ phoenix-az-mega-tourny], DeckTech (Charles "Teacher" Hickey, 13 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-13-phoenix-az-mega-tournyd1457/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
* Clint Hays says Steven Lewis went 2–2 at the Grand Slam and dropped; Brian Hunter's Day 3 report says Lewis dropped at 3–1. The hub's Lewis list 'How To Cook A Chevin' gives a posted 4–0.<ref name="tr-d1464" />
